_doc: Waystation 9 props: the Remand Program's trader relay post built into the Cordon wall where the river leaves the valley (checkpoint kit: olive corrugated steel, hesco cages, sandbags, yellow-black hazard paint, floodlights on a generator). Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_waystation.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z), measured from the clean model; every footprint is centred on the origin (bottom centre). Each model also ships per-part -convcolonly collision boxes (the kiosk's leave its standing space free).

defs.name: Trade Kiosk
defs.description: Olive corrugated booth with a wide serving hatch over a plank counter, the mesh grille rolled up above it, a chalk board of scrip rates, stock on the shelves inside and a work lamp. The quartermaster trades from inside.
defs._trader_spot: Prop-local Godot metres: the trader stands at (x -0.30, z -0.05) on the ground (y 0), facing +Z through the hatch; the free standing box behind the counter spans x -1.00..0.45, z -0.76..0.30 (counter top 1.05 m, hatch opening x -1.20..0.60, y 1.05..2.05). The side doorway is on the -X wall (z -0.65..0.05). collision 'mesh' marks that the box-from-size stand-in would enclose the trader: place it with the model's own collision boxes.

defs.name: Contracts Board
defs.description: Plywood notice board on two posts under a tin roof: the CONTRACTS header, a Program bulletin, contract forms, a bounty sheet, scrawled slips and a valley map ringed in red.

defs.name: Guard Tower
defs.description: Timber guard tower on splayed, braced legs: a sandbagged deck behind a corrugated skirt at 4.5 m, a tin roof, a floodlight and a ladder up the back.

defs.name: Hesco Barrier
defs.description: Three earth-filled wire-mesh cages lined with geotextile, a coil of concertina wire along the top.

defs.name: Boom Gate
defs.description: Checkpoint boom: a counterweighted yellow pedestal with an amber beacon, a hazard-striped arm on its rest fork and a HALT plate hung from it.

defs.name: Waystation 9 Sign
defs.description: Painted steel sign on two posts: WAYSTATION 9 in big stencils, REMAND PROGRAM under it, the Program roundel and a hazard band, streaked with rust.

defs.name: Floodlight Pole
defs.description: Steel pole on a concrete block with two floodlight heads, its cable taped down the pole and run to a portable generator at its foot.

defs.name: Program Supply Stack
defs.description: Stencilled Program crates, drums and ammo cans strapped on a pallet, a drum standing beside it.
